title: Store settings
foundationHelp: Store configuration and account access are ready. Catalog and commerce workflows will follow in later phases.
name: Store name
logoHelp: Upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF image up to 5 MB. The header uses it after you save.
faviconHelp: The browser tab uses this image after you save. Remove it to keep the default icon.
uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
colorHelp: Leave a color blank to keep the current navy and orange. This does not change the rest of the theme.
socialHelp: Use https links. Blank fields stay hidden on the storefront.
accountsHelp: Disabling accounts blocks customer sign-in and account access. Owner and staff access remains available. Order preferences will take effect when commerce is implemented.
